variants.headline: Strike collapses
variants.body: A strike has collapsed in {colony}. Give {target} a fair hearing; outrage alone should not be allowed to write the whole verdict.

variants.headline: Labour action loses its course
variants.body: The colony has seen a strike collapse. Give {target} a fair hearing; outrage alone should not be allowed to write the whole verdict.

variants.headline: A strike ends in collapse
variants.body: A strike in the colony has ended in collapse. Give {target} a fair hearing; outrage alone should not be allowed to write the whole verdict.
